name: io.github.cyKim0115/unity-emu-lab
title: Unity Emu Lab
description: Self-test Unity builds: Android emulator smoke tests with a shared device lease, and WebGL in Chrome

environmentVariables.name: ANDROID_SDK_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Android SDK folder (default: Windows %USERPROFILE%\Android\Sdk, macOS ~/Library/Android/sdk, Linux ~/Android/Sdk)

environmentVariables.name: EMU_AVD
environmentVariables.description: AVD to lease and boot (default unity-test)

environmentVariables.name: EMU_ADB
environmentVariables.description: adb executable to use, e.g. the one inside Unity so only one adb version runs

environmentVariables.name: EMU_OWNER
environmentVariables.description: Lease owner name (default: Claude Code session, Codex thread, or user@host)

environmentVariables.name: EMU_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Chrome, Edge or Chromium executable for the WebGL smoke test (default: usual install locations, then PATH)
